The horizon of human ambition has always been defined by the tools we build and the frontiers we dare to cross. In a digital landscape where cultural trends shift by the minute, a singular, brief interaction on the X platform has ignited a global conversation about the ultimate trajectory of our species. The moment unfolded with deceptive simplicity: a one-word reply from Elon Musk that carries weight across the tech world and scientific community.The interaction began when a prominent futurist account, known for pushing the boundaries of techno-optimism and extreme technological accelerationism under the handle beffjezos, published a deeply ambitious blueprint for the future of intelligent life. This was not a standard prediction for the next decade, but rather a multi-century roadmap designed to transition humanity from a planetary species into a cosmic force. The post outlined a structured, highly strategic sequence of milestones aimed at ensuring the permanent survival and exponential expansion of https://t.co/q6oDSZna1h the core of this vision is the immediate colonization of the Moon. Rather than viewing Earth's natural satellite merely as a site for scientific research or symbolic footprints, the proposal positions the lunar surface as the foundational stepping stone for industrializing space. The Moon’s low gravity and abundant raw materials make it the perfect launchpad for manufacturing massive infrastructure without the heavy energy costs of escaping Earth's deep gravity well.According to the outlined plan, a permanent lunar presence is the critical catalyst required to achieve the next phase: the construction of an Artificial Intelligence-driven Dyson Swarm. A Dyson Swarm represents a theoretical mega-engineering project consisting of a vast network of power-collecting satellites orbiting a star to capture its massive energy output. By utilizing autonomous, self-replicating AI systems powered by lunar manufacturing hubs, humanity could construct a solar-harvesting apparatus capable of capturing nearly all of the Sun’s 384 yottawatts of energy. This level of power would completely detach human progress from the energy scarcities of Earth.Acquiring this unprecedented level of energy would officially launch our civilization up the Kardashev scale. The Kardashev scale is a method used by physicists to measure a civilization's level of technological advancement based on the amount of energy they are able to utilize. Currently, Earth operates as a Type 0 civilization, reliant on planetary fossil fuels and limited renewable resources. Securing a Dyson Swarm would elevate us to a true Type II civilization, possessing the capacity to control and direct the entire energy output of our host star.With the energy of a Type II civilization unlocked, the final phase of the outlined vision becomes entirely possible: the execution of multi-star human civilization expansion. The boundless energy reserves would fuel interstellar travel, terraforming initiatives, and the establishment of permanent human colonies across neighboring star systems, effectively guaranteeing that the light of consciousness will never be extinguished by a single planetary catastrophe.
Accompanying this massive text was a striking, highly detailed AI-generated image that gave a tangible visual form to these sci-fi concepts. The image depicts Elon Musk standing directly on the lunar surface. He is not clad in a traditional, bulky white astronaut suit, but is instead wearing a sleek, tailored business suit that seamlessly integrates advanced life-support technology—symbolizing the commercialization and normalization of space travel. Beside him, an American flag is planted firmly into the gray lunar soil, signaling the geopolitical and pioneering spirit driving this new space https://t.co/NsWuaDBxJM the immediate background, stretching across the dusty horizon, is a long, low-slung, ultra-modern lunar base structure. This sprawling complex features geometric architecture, reinforced domes, and functional launch bays, suggesting a bustling hub of research and industrial manufacturing. Hovering majestically in the deep black sky above the base is the vibrant blue and white marble of Earth, serving as a distant reminder of where this grand cosmic journey began. The imagery perfectly bridges the gap between contemporary corporate leadership and the limitless frontier of deep space.The post immediately captured the attention of millions, but its impact exploded exponentially when Elon Musk himself engaged with it. Known for his role as the chief engineer of SpaceX and a vocal proponent of making humanity a multi-planetary species, Musk directly quoted the expansive thesis. His response was characteristically minimal yet monumental: a simple, definitive "Yes."This single word from the world’s most prominent space entrepreneur transformed a theoretical internet manifesto into a validated corporate and technological mission statement. By explicitly endorsing the progression from a lunar base to an AI Dyson Swarm and interstellar expansion, Musk has reaffirmed his belief that the destiny of intelligent life lies far beyond our atmosphere. The interaction serves as a stark reminder that while the challenges of the present demand our attention, the architects of tomorrow are already calculating how to harvest the stars.

HON. NOAH AHMED — EMPOWERING THE GEN Z GENERATION

Hon. Noah Ahmed’s proposed vision for young people is built on one fundamental principle: young people should not only be the leaders of tomorrow—they should have meaningful opportunities to contribute today.

His youth empowerment agenda would focus on turning the energy, creativity and innovation of Gen Z into skills, businesses, employment and sustainable livelihoods across Taraba State.

Under this proposed vision, youth development would include:

💡 TECHNOLOGY & DIGITAL SKILLS
Create opportunities for young people to learn AI, cybersecurity, software development, digital marketing, graphics, content creation and other emerging technologies.

🚀 STARTUP & BUSINESS SPONSORSHIP
Support promising youth-owned businesses through transparent grants, equipment, mentorship and access to business development programmes—not just one-time handouts.

🎓 EDUCATION & SCHOLARSHIPS
Expand opportunities for scholarships, vocational training, professional certifications and technical education so that financial hardship does not prevent talented young people from developing their potential.

🎨 CREATIVE INDUSTRY SUPPORT
Provide structured support for musicians, filmmakers, photographers, designers, writers, fashion entrepreneurs and other creatives through training, sponsorship and platforms for showcasing their work.

⚽ SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
Invest in grassroots sports by supporting young athletes, coaches and sporting programmes, while creating pathways for talented youths to compete at higher levels.

💼 JOBS, INTERNSHIPS & ENTREPRENEURSHIP
Build partnerships with private businesses and institutions to create internships, apprenticeships and employment opportunities while helping young entrepreneurs develop sustainable enterprises.

🏢 YOUTH INNOVATION CENTRES
Develop spaces where young people can access training, internet connectivity, mentorship, technology and collaborative opportunities.

A NEW APPROACH TO YOUTH SPONSORSHIP

The goal should be to move from “giving young people something” to “giving young people the tools to build something.”

Every sponsorship programme should be transparent, merit-based and accessible to young people across communities and local government areas.

HON. NOAH AHMED’S MESSAGE TO THE GEN Z GENERATION:

> “Your ideas matter. Your talent matters. Your future matters. Government should create an environment where a young person with an idea, skill or dream has a genuine opportunity to turn that potential into reality.”

Empower the youth. Invest in talent. Sponsor innovation. Create opportunity. Build a stronger Taraba.

Today, we are announcing Arena's factuality leaderboards, which evaluate the objective performance of AI models in reality and guard against hallucinations.

Arena's chat leaderboard has historically focused on human preference. Although our style control methodology adjusts for the effect of emojis, response length, and other stylistic factors, we wanted a more direct way of measuring objective signals of chatbot utility and anti-hallucination.

Hence, we developed the factuality leaderboards, which speak to the fraction of correct factual claims that a model makes. We basically extract all factual claims and cross-reference them against the internet to ensure they are based in evidence. Models that are supporting their claims with stronger evidence get a better score, and this gives a strong basis for objective performance beyond preference alone.

The big winners, as you can see on this plot, are OpenAI and Grok. Notably, Claude models, as well as Ernie and Muse-Spark-1.1, decrease in ranking.

A 21-YEAR-OLD CHINESE GIRL MAKES $12,000+ A MONTH WITH A DANCING ANIME GIRL THAT DOESN’T EVEN EXIST

No, I’m not talking about game development or animation.

She simply dances in front of a camera.

AI turns every movement, facial expression, and gesture into a realistic anime avatar that copies her perfectly.

That’s the version she posts online. Not herself.

Millions of people follow the character. Most of them don’t even care who’s controlling it.

Fashion brands pay the avatar to wear their clothes. Beauty companies pay the avatar to promote their products. Gaming studios pay the avatar to appear in campaigns.

The audience never bought into the AI. They bought into the personality.

That’s the biggest misconception about AI creators.

People don’t follow technology. They follow characters they enjoy watching.

The creators who understand that first will build the next generation of internet celebrities.

Update on our robot learning project with @aboraatakan at @uwwatai.

We went from ~30% to 99.8% success on our pick-and-place task by updating our policy from a DINO ViT + transformer policy to a CNN + MLP. Our old model was memorizing the training data and transferring poorly to closed-loop rollouts, so we went the other way and made the model smaller.

The attached video is the CNN + MLP policy running in sim on our async inference stack. We demoed it live for a few hours: 4 failures over 2000+ randomized scenes. This experience has been useful to confirm our stack's correctness. We are now ready to move to hardware!

Next: real hardware, diffusion policy, open-weight fine-tunes, and RL.

Reach out if you're interested in collaborating, and stay tuned.

Rather than optimizing a diffusion policy with unstable RL objectives, EvoHIL combines a self-evolving reward model with flow matching optimization.

The policy learns from better rewards, while better policies generate stronger preference data for the next reward update. Each component bootstraps the other.
